title: Early Experience: Data Construction + Dual-Branch Training (IWM & SR)

nodes.label: Expert Dataset D_expert
nodes.semantic_desc: Expert demonstration pairs D_expert={(s_i,a_i)}; provides expert states s_i and expert actions a_i as anchors for sampling and supervised training.
nodes.visual_desc: A stacked dataset card labeled 'D_expert' with two columns 's' and 'a'; small row snippets to suggest (state, action) tuples.

nodes.label: State s_i
nodes.semantic_desc: A single expert state sampled from D_expert; used as context to query the initial policy for alternative actions and to compare future outcomes.
nodes.visual_desc: A small rounded rectangle showing a minimal 'state' glyph: grid/world icon + token strip to imply textual/structured state.

nodes.label: Expert Action a_i
nodes.semantic_desc: The expert action associated with state s_i; executed in the environment to obtain expert-next state s_{i+1}, and used as the supervised IL target.
nodes.visual_desc: A compact action token chip labeled 'a_i' (single discrete token-like pill).

nodes.label: Initial LLM Policy π0
nodes.semantic_desc: Starting LLM policy; takes state s_i as input and samples K non-expert candidate actions {a_i^1..a_i^K} for early experience generation.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle module box with solid primary color (#4A90D9) and white centered text 'Initial LLM Policy π0' plus a small transformer-layer icon.

nodes.label: K Candidate Actions
nodes.semantic_desc: A set of sampled non-expert actions {a_i^1, a_i^2, ..., a_i^K} conditioned on s_i; forwarded to environment rollout execution.
nodes.visual_desc: A fan-out of K small action pills (a^1, a^2, …, a^K) arranged in an arc to imply multiple samples.

nodes.label: Environment Simulator
nodes.semantic_desc: Execution environment; takes (s_i, action) and produces the corresponding next/rollout future state (either s_{i+1} for expert action or s_i^j for candidate actions).
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Environment' with a simple gridworld/maze icon and a right-pointing step arrow.

nodes.label: Expert Next State s_{i+1}
nodes.semantic_desc: Future state resulting from executing the expert action a_i at state s_i; serves as a reference outcome for self-reflection comparisons.
nodes.visual_desc: A small state glyph box labeled 's_{i+1}' with a subtle 'star' marker to denote expert outcome.

nodes.label: Rollout Next States {s_i^j}
nodes.semantic_desc: Set of future states obtained by executing each candidate action a_i^j from s_i; used as reward-free supervision targets in IWM and as contrastive evidence in SR.
nodes.visual_desc: A row/stack of small state glyph boxes labeled s^1, s^2, …, s^K, each connected to a corresponding action pill (visual grouping only).

nodes.label: Rollout Triples D_rollout
nodes.semantic_desc: Constructed rollout dataset D_rollout={(s_i, a_i^j, s_i^j)}; provides (state, candidate action) with future-state supervision for world modeling and reflection.
nodes.visual_desc: A dataset table card labeled 'D_rollout' with three columns 's', 'a^j', 's^j' and tiny arrow glyph from (s,a) to s^j.

nodes.label: IWM Module
nodes.semantic_desc: Implicit World Modeling branch; takes (s_i, a_i^j) from D_rollout and trains the LLM to predict future state s_i^j via next-token prediction formulation.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Implicit World Modeling (IWM)' with a small crystal-ball/trajectory icon and transformer glyph.

nodes.label: Future-State Prediction
nodes.semantic_desc: Model-predicted future state tokens corresponding to s_i^j; compared against rollout future states to compute the IWM learning signal.
nodes.visual_desc: A token strip labeled 'ŝ_i^j' (hat) with a short sequence of rectangles representing tokens, ending with a small arrow to a state glyph.

nodes.label: NLL Loss (IWM)
nodes.semantic_desc: Negative log-likelihood loss for IWM; takes predicted future-state tokens and ground-truth rollout future states to produce gradients for policy updating.
nodes.visual_desc: A small orange (#fc8d62) loss node: sigma-like symbol 'ℒ_NLL' with a downward arrow indicating minimization.

nodes.label: SR Module
nodes.semantic_desc: Self-Reflection branch; takes s_i, expert outcome s_{i+1}, and candidate outcomes s_i^j to generate natural language critique/explanation c_i^j stating why expert action is better.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Self-Reflection (SR)' with a speech-bubble icon and a compare icon (≻) inside.

nodes.label: Reflection Text c_i^j
nodes.semantic_desc: Generated natural-language rationale indicating expert action advantage; used to build reflection supervision pairs for joint training.
nodes.visual_desc: A speech bubble containing short pseudo-text lines (no readable words), with a small '≻' marker in the corner.

nodes.label: Reflection Dataset D_refl
nodes.semantic_desc: Constructed dataset D_refl={(s_i, a_i^j, c_i^j)}; provides state + candidate action paired with reflective explanation targets for SR training.
nodes.visual_desc: A dataset card labeled 'D_refl' with columns 's', 'a^j', 'c' where 'c' column is represented by speech-bubble glyphs.

nodes.label: Joint Policy Training
nodes.semantic_desc: Combined training stage; takes D_expert and D_refl (and optionally IWM-updated policy) to optimize the LLM policy to predict expert actions a_i and reflection texts c_i^j.
nodes.visual_desc: A large rounded rectangle labeled 'Joint Training (IL + SR)' with two small input ports and one transformer icon in the center.

nodes.label: Updated LLM Policy π
nodes.semantic_desc: Trained policy after Early Experience; outputs improved action distributions conditioned on state and can optionally produce reflective explanations.
nodes.visual_desc: A prominent rounded rectangle with a darker primary border and centered label 'Updated Policy π'; small arrow-up glyph to indicate improvement.
